question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e823e7f5a13fb7470aa7d346ef0f2b9c82f90f9b42e9b47cf5f323f3602bd5b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58666426f2ed45f20901cbdd9dc6862ac5493650091d72c986b18e77022737df.png] 

⇒ 4² + 3² = 13 + 12

⇒ 16 + 9 = 25

⇒ 25 = 25 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78a214ecb31e92cf1a7d0b0c9facdaf1b24c5d5241b2c08c2589d819cce392c7.png] 

⇒ 22 + 92 = 25 + 60

⇒ 4 + 81 = 85

⇒ 85 = 85 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a94e60bdf7e2e07e04dbb2f133ddfab00a1a27cfb3bbac8a920668b37918d00f.png] 

⇒ 52 + ?2 = 19 + 15

⇒ ? = √(34 - 25)

⇒ ? = √9

⇒ **? = 3**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
